name: pumi-chat-ui
description: A chat view for Claude Code, Codex and pi tabs: the same live session, drawn as a chat you can type into, with the terminal one click away.

images.alt: A Claude Code session as a chat: messages, a tool call, a permission card and the prompt

modes.label: Modes
modes.desc: How each agent opens, by its id: `off`, `terminal`, `chat` (the terminal with the chat over it), `acp` or `sdk`. Settings → Chat UI sets it with a dropdown per agent; an agent left out has its default.

key.label: Key
key.desc: A chord that flips the focused agent tab between its terminal and the chat (the root key table). Empty for none; the title bar's button and the command work regardless.

history_mb.label: History read
history_mb.desc: How much of the end of a session file the chat reads when it opens. Older turns are left out of a bigger file.

bun.label: Bun
bun.desc: The Bun that runs each ACP or SDK tab's host process. Empty: the app's own.

commands.title: Chat UI: flip the focused tab between the terminal and the chat
Chat UI: continue this terminal agent in a chat tab (ACP or SDK)
Chat UI: continue this chat tab's session in the agent's terminal
